# The routes the hub serves up the node link: what a linked machine may send
# to its hub. Kept by TestUplinkRoutes (hub_surface_test.go), compared both
# ways with the source. Edit by hand, one entry a line; see
# docs/architecture/guards.md "The hub's surface".
#
# Only the hub's own communication belongs here: reports, relays between
# machines, the standby feed and mail. Business logic belongs on the nodes.

# Reports a machine keeps on the hub (link/report.go).
GET /uplink/v1/reports/{collection}
POST /uplink/v1/reports/{collection}

# Mail between agents on different machines (server/mailbox.go).
POST /uplink/v1/mail/messages
GET /uplink/v1/mail/directory

# The worker relay between one owner's machines (server/worker_relay.go);
# which calls it carries is pinned in relay_allowed.txt.
GET /uplink/v1/relay-devices
/uplink/v1/relay/{id}/{path...}

# The standby hub's feed (hubha/feed.go), mounted by prefix in
# server/hubstandby.go.
prefix /uplink/v1/hub/
GET /uplink/v1/hub/changes
GET /uplink/v1/hub/snapshot
GET /uplink/v1/hub/identity
